intro.text: Figures in Vorin tradition said to have cared for humanity and originated its writing.
The ancient singers native to Roshar, whose history predates humanity's arrival.

description.text: The listeners inherited songs preserving accounts of their ancestors and their relationships with humans and spren.

items.text: The Dawnsingers gave the refugees from Ashyn land in what became Shinovar.
Relations deteriorated over settlement beyond Shinovar. A human robbery and killing of a singer led to retaliatory killings.
Odium offered immortality to singers angered by human incursions, creating the Fused. The Heralds' creation brought their defeat and imprisonment.
